remarks: Welcome to River Terrace. The perfect blend of space, comfort, and convenience in this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit. Ideally located near parks, tennis courts, golf courses, shops, and restaurants, this home offers an open-concept living and dining area with sliding doors leading to a spacious deck overlooking the river. Kitchen features elegant granite countertops, perfect for any home chef. The primary bedroom boasts its own private bath, while the second bedroom is generously sized with a nearby full hall bath, making it ideal for guests. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer, an intercom system, and ample storage options-with shared storage space in the basement.Enjoy the ease of 1 reserved parking along with 2nd parking in unassigned guest parking. Located just minutes from Stamford's vibrant downtown and offering quick access to Greenwich, this 1,325 sq. ft. second-floor unit provides an exceptional living experience.
